issue.title: Document Project 4 Fluent Mobile Board as canonical tracker
issue.body:
## Summary

Repo Issues list is deprecated as the source of truth for triage/columns. Canonical board is org Project 4 view 9 (Fluent Mobile Board).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/issue-tracking.md` states Project 4 / Fluent Mobile Board (view 9) is canonical for status/columns
- [ ] `delivery.mdc` and related agent pointers no longer treat the bare repo Issues URL as primary tracker
- [ ] Ticket numbers `#NNN` remain (cards are still repo issues on the project)

## Links

- Board: https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9
